title: main 分支 sync 跟 miao/testing — 3 merge commit divergent + 长期 lag 债
description:
PR #150 canary 抓到 main 分支落后 testing 16 commits + 独有 3 merge commits (diverged). 根因: 长期 miao-only 开发, main 分支只在少数 PR (#139, #141, #145) 通过 merge commit 收过 miao 的部分内容, 但从没做真正的 fast-forward sync.

**已 confirmed main 独有 3 commits (全 merge commit, 无独立内容)**:
- b99fada Merge pull request #145 from godlockin/testing
- bb93164 Merge pull request #141 from godlockin/miao
- fbdc73e Merge pull request #139 from godlockin/miao

**修法** (跟 EPIC-142 testing sync 模式一致, force-push 到 miao HEAD):
1. 确认 v3.30.0 内容全在 testing (feature/v3.30.0-EPIC-140-to-142 已 merge 4307d2f2)
2. `git push origin origin/testing:refs/heads/main --force` (main = testing HEAD)
3. 验证 `git log origin/main..origin/testing | wc -l` = 0
4. 更新 CLAUDE.md branch-flow-governance 段加 main sync record (跟 EPIC-142 testing sync 段并列)

**注意**: main 的 3 merge commit 内容都是历史 miao → main 的 subset, 已经在 testing HEAD 里, force-push 不丢内容.

**验收**:
- git log origin/main..origin/testing 输出 0 lines
- git log origin/testing..origin/main 输出 0 lines (完全对齐)
- CLAUDE.md 加 sync record
- 下一个 testing → main PR 只查本 PR commits, 不 pollute base

**追责链**: PR #150 canary — 4-branch flow 第一次真走到 main 暴露长期 miao-only 开发债. 跟 EPIC-142 是 sister ticket.
acceptance: origin/main = origin/testing HEAD (git log 0 diff 双向)
CLAUDE.md branch-flow-governance 段加 main sync record + v3.30.0 追溯 row
无内容丢失 (main 独有 3 merge commit 都是 testing subset, 已 confirm)
